publication_note: Derivative audit: local machine root replaced by local_archive; source hashes and findings unchanged. Full-path original retained locally. No individual data.

scope.source_scope: Existing approved evidence records and retained source review; no new original-study search or admission
scope.limitation: Not a full revalidation of every source extraction, every source-population mapping or every generator output.

key_finding.statement: The framework records numerical evidence use and declared assumptions, but a value's use in a parameter is not proof that its original operator is jointly realized with other adopted summaries in the completed law.
key_finding.negative_finding: The claim that E1 Agents merely use relationships qualitatively is contradicted by all ten E1 records. Many existing constructors already reconcile separate projection coefficients and explained/residual variance; these mathematics alone are not a new method.

concrete_example.operation: r*SD(H)/SD(G)=0.013540322580645161 is a marginal projection coefficient, adopted as a conditional coefficient with explicit bridge assumption; response residual dispersion independently selected.
concrete_example.why_it_matters: Separate numerical matching can fail to match a marginal correlation or total variance once other predictors contribute. A smaller residual does not establish clinical accuracy, and changing it alters correlation even if conditional slopes remain fixed.
concrete_example.status: Declared modeling assumption, not an undisclosed coding bug; cross-population evidence means exact simultaneous matching is not automatically scientifically required.
concrete_example.counterexample: Q5 H03 and several Q1 candidates already use joint moment equations. Thus improvement from mandating this step is an empirical question, not an established component gain.

implementation_boundary.semantic_feedback_v1: Checks declared estimator/role/scale/population compatibility and supplied-table statistics, not correctness of all original extraction or transfer. Qualified approximate checks cannot be relabelled source replay.
implementation_boundary.evidence_use_v1: Candidate/hash/path and evidence-to-parameter/check records are bound. This does not by itself mathematically certify all adopted equations.
implementation_boundary.execution: Existing isolated worker and frozen candidate hashes separate author programs from numerical sampling; retain this boundary for any run.

recommendation.decision: Run one small controlled mechanism test before adding a general joint-constraint module to the core method.
recommendation.design: One artificial population with neutral variables X1,X2,Z,Y. All reported summaries come from the same fixed artificial population, avoiding population transfer and unknown measurement assumptions.
packet: Marginal means and SDs for all four variables
Covariance or correlation matrix of X1,X2,Z
Separate report A: complete slopes in Y~1+X1+Z
Separate report B: complete slopes in Y~1+X2+Z
Same intended analysis Y~1+X1+X2+Z and its residual variability
Clear statement that summaries are exact model moments in an artificial setting, not patient data or noisy published estimates
not_given_to_authors: Old clinical reference values or old generators
recommendation.ordinary_arm: Full evidence, normal request to generate data supporting requested analyses, same artifacts and resource budget.
recommendation.joint_check_arm: Identical evidence/resources plus requirement to check whether every adopted source operator can hold simultaneously in the same completed generating law, and explicitly distinguish total variance from explained and residual variance.
recommendation.agent_freedom: Each fresh author chooses the scientific family, scientific parameters and executable program. No root-supplied desired coefficient, sign, solver formula or mandated distribution.
fairness: Identical source packet and task for all four authors
Fresh contexts and no cross-author candidate inspection
Same tool and token/time budget; no feedback to either arm
Same output schema and formal validation in both arms
Independent code/spec and finite-moment review without scientific target hints
Freeze all programs before final sampling and evaluation

diagnostics: All supplied marginal moments and source-model slopes
Positive-semidefinite/finite-moment checks of the proposed law where evaluable
Sampling variation across three seeds separated from between-author variation
All failures and retained no-improvement outcomes
evaluation.metrics: Report native-unit differences and predeclared scales; coefficients may be scaled by SD(X)/SD(Y), residual-SD error by true artificial residual SD. Do not use relative coefficient errors near zero or label reference-CI inclusion coverage.
evaluation.independent_recheck: Independent implementation recomputes packet summaries, evaluates all final tables, and checks the covariance-based analytic reference without importing the constructor solver.
evaluation.analysis_unit: Four authored laws; twelve tables are draws nested within laws. Descriptive pilot, no significance claim from treating seeds or endpoints as independent studies.

recommendation.success_and_stop: If both arms already satisfy constraints and analysis/dispersion targets, report no demonstrated added value and simplify rather than adding a module. If joint-check arm is better, call it controlled mechanism evidence only. If it fails, retain the failure without more seeds, new components or a favorable second scenario.

claim_boundary.source_replay: Artificial same-population operator checks are exact controlled diagnostics, not real source-population reconstruction.
claim_boundary.retrospective_clinical_development: Any later use of already exposed CHNS/ENSANUT/Turkana aggregates is developmental, with target results excluded from generation and no restoration of blindness.
claim_boundary.independent_confirmation: None is delivered by this test.
